verdict.rationale: n8n ships self-hosting via Docker/CLI and supports environment promotion (dev/test/prod) via 'source control and environments' push/pull, plus a command-line interface for local runs, which together enable local/dev-instance workflow execution. However, there is no explicit documentation of a CI testing framework, automated test runners, or headless workflow execution for pipelines. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/testing tooling docs, automated workflow test execution examples, and independent hands-on confirmation of CI use.
